locales.description: BCP-47 locale tags to ship, e.g. ["en", "fr", "ar"]. The first is the source locale unless --default-locale says otherwise.

defaultLocale.description: The source locale: what untranslated keys fall back to. Defaults to the first entry of locales.

apps.description: Applications to wire. Defaults to every application; a prerendered site is built once per locale rather than switched at runtime.
